title: Find free candidates for the plant sound and bring them to be heard
tier_reason: The design note now specifies exactly what the sound needs to do; sourcing it is the concrete next step and it's Dmitri's seat.
ask: Daniel's ruling 2026-09-04: free-to-use sounds are tried first and brought to him as a card he can listen to; foley recording is only for what nothing free can cover, and it is batched because a session costs him an afternoon. So this card is the search, and it is not held by the look pick — only the recording batch is.
first_action: Search the free/CC0 sources for a soft, low pat-pat — soil closing over a seed, reading as tucking in rather than as a reward, per the design note in docs/design/10-audio-direction.md. Bring back two to four candidates as a decision card in hq/data/decisions/ with each sound attached, each carrying its source URL and licence, and a recommendation. If nothing clears the bar, say so and add plant to the foley batch instead — that is a real result.
